scope: Two known services; cpu/mem/delay; separate repetitions of the same fault recipes, not unseen-fault generalization.
known_limit: Out-of-scope faults can resemble supported patterns. False acceptance is reported and no repair is executed.
notes: One initial development run exposed fixed-amplitude and propagated-latency issues. V2 derives minimum amplitude from the reference, applies the same resource-priority rule in B/C, and ranks by current intensity with case similarity. No holdout result had been inspected when this artifact was created.
